"""Trusted entrypoint for a workspace-bound native numerical analysis script."""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

_AGENT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(_AGENT))


def main() -> None:
    from src.tools.mona_python_tool import validate_analysis

    workspace = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(strict=True)
    script = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve(strict=True)
    if not script.is_relative_to(workspace) or not script.is_file():
        raise ValueError("analysis script is outside its workspace")
    source = script.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    validate_analysis(source)
    read_roots = [workspace, _AGENT, Path(sys.prefix).resolve(), Path(sys.base_prefix).resolve()]
    shared = Path(sys.argv[3]).resolve(strict=True)
    if shared != workspace and (shared.name != "artifacts" or not workspace.is_relative_to(shared)):
        raise ValueError("analysis shared inputs do not belong to this task")
    read_roots.append(shared)
    # Runner always creates an ephemeral HOME in hosted mode. Numerical library
    # caches may write there; persistent application data is not granted.
    ephemeral = Path(os.environ.get("HOME") or os.environ["USERPROFILE"]).resolve()
    read_roots.append(ephemeral)
    write_roots = [workspace, ephemeral]
    system_root = os.environ.get("SYSTEMROOT")
    if system_root:
        read_roots.append(Path(system_root).resolve())
    sys.path[:] = [str(_AGENT), *[item for item in sys.path if item and not Path(item).resolve().is_relative_to(workspace)]]

    def within(value, roots):
        if isinstance(value, int):
            return
        path = Path(os.fsdecode(value)).resolve()
        if not any(path.is_relative_to(root) for root in roots):
            raise PermissionError("analysis file access is outside the supplied workspace and libraries")

    def audit(event, args):
        if event == "open":
            mode = args[1] or ""
            flags = args[2] if len(args) > 2 and isinstance(args[2], int) else 0
            writing = any(letter in str(mode) for letter in "wax+") or flags & (os.O_WRONLY | os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_TRUNC | os.O_APPEND)
            within(args[0], write_roots if writing else read_roots)
        elif event in {"os.listdir", "os.scandir"}:
            within(args[0] or workspace, read_roots)
        elif event in {"os.remove", "os.rmdir", "os.mkdir", "os.chmod"}:
            within(args[0], write_roots)
        elif event in {"os.rename", "os.replace"}:
            within(args[0], write_roots)
            within(args[1], write_roots)
        elif event.startswith("socket.") or event in {
            "subprocess.Popen", "os.system", "os.posix_spawn", "os.exec", "os.fork",
            "os.kill", "os.killpg", "os.symlink", "os.link", "os.startfile",
        }:
            raise PermissionError("network, shell, process control and links are unavailable in research analysis")

    os.chdir(workspace)
    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
    sys.argv = [str(script)]
    sys.addaudithook(audit)
    namespace = {"__name__": "__main__", "__file__": str(script)}
    exec(compile(source, str(script), "exec"), namespace)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
